credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/skunk_cabbage.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. REARING: the maroon hood (spathe), mottled with green, pushing up through the snow in its own melt hollow, its tip hooked toward the foe, a tight rolled leaf spike behind it. The mouth is a tall slit with the knobbly spadix low inside (no glint, so it never reads as an eye). Gesture: the plant heats itself, so a curl of steam rises off the hood, swirls and thins away. Two hues: spathe maroon in the dark slot; the leaf shades to black. Sport: a yellow-green spathe (the natural colour range of wild spathes; no named form exists).
